name: Holiday Lights Celebration at City Hall Plaza
host: City of Gainesville Parks, Recreation and Cultural Affairs
paras: Gainesville holds its annual Holiday Lights Celebration on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm at City Hall Plaza, 200 E. University Ave. The city says this is the first year the celebration takes place at the newly renovated plaza. Admission is free, and the evening includes a holiday tree lighting with Mayor Harvey Ward and a visit from Santa.

The city's page promises train rides, Santa and Grinch Villages, holiday lights, seasonal activities and live entertainment. The stage lineup includes the Gainesville Youth Chorus, Sun Country Dance Theatre, Star Center Theatre and the Next Generation company of Dance Alive National Ballet, along with several other local groups.
tip: The city lists the performing groups but no stage times, so plan to arrive near the 5 pm start.

name: Holiday Kids' Dance Party at Bo Diddley Plaza
host: City of Gainesville Parks, Recreation and Cultural Affairs
paras: The City of Gainesville hosts a Holiday Kids' Dance Party on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 1:30 to 3 pm at Bo Diddley Plaza, 111 E. University Ave. DJ E-LO runs the music, and the city invites kids to dance, sing and celebrate the holidays. Admission is free.

Food trucks are on site, and the food is available for purchase. The party falls on the same day as the city's Holiday Lights Celebration, which starts at 5 pm at City Hall Plaza. Both events are on East University Avenue, so families can plan one afternoon and evening around them.
tip: Bring a little cash or a card, because food truck items are sold separately.
